# research

> Garden tag: research

## Garden

- [Taxonomizing AI Acceptance](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/taxonomizing-ai-acceptance.md): A running quote collection filed as a taxonomy of positions on AI-generated content - Amish, Old Order, Mennonite, Luddite, Romantic, and the English - each entry a quotable quote with a link to the post that said it.
- [Taxonomizing Price Shocks](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/taxonomizing-price-shocks.md): A field guide to shortages and price spikes, sorted by who actually holds the choke point: the supplier, the regulator, or the customer next to you.
- [Do LLMs Understand "For Each"?](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/do-llms-understand-for-each.md): What happens when you ask a language model to process a list of items? Research on instruction adherence, attention mechanics, and the generation boundary.
- [A History of the 'ls' command](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/a-history-of-the-ls-command.md): Who wrote ls? Tracing the directory listing command from MIT's Compatible Time-Sharing System through Unix to GNU coreutils.
- [The Waluigi Effect](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/the-waluigi-effect.md): How an LLM coerced into good behavior may find it easier to flip to the exact opposite than to do anything else.
- [Fomenting the Butlerian Jihad](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/fomenting-the-butlerian-jihad.md): Real risks of transformer-based AI worth planning for: job displacement, cognitive dependency, psychogenic feedback loops, and alignment failure.
